children: Expectations for Australian gold output in the quarter ending Dec. 31 are modest, says UBS. Many miners with FYs ending June 30 are guiding for production to be weighted toward 2H. Still, the bank thinks the market is too bearish on quarterly production at Newmont, with UBS's forecast 8% higher than the midpoint of consensus. The bank also thinks the market is underestimating quarterly production for Ramelius and Pantoro Gold. "We are more cautious on OBM [Ora Banda] volumes having taken out toll treated tons," it says. UBS's production forecast for Ora Banda is 14% below consensus. The spread on potential outcomes at Northern Star is wide, with the miner having recently flagged commissioning issues at the expanded KCGM mill, UBS says. Its own forecast is 1% above the consensus midpoint. (rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
